request.description:
# Request

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| query | FeedsSearchQuery | Return results that match FeedsSearchQuery definition. See FeedsSearchQuery documentation below. |
| paged | PagedRequest | Specify count, sort property and sort direction. See PagedRequest documentation below. |
| scrollToken | String | Include scrollToken from response in your next request to paginate over results. If scrollToken is not returned, you have reached the last page of your results. |

### **FeedsSearchQuery**

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mentionFilter | MentionFilter | Only return results that match MentionFilter definition. See MentionFilter documentation below. |
| feedTime | DateInterval | Return results by specifying DateInterval of mention entering your feed. |
| publishedTime | DateInterval | Return results by specifying DateInterval of mention published date. |

#### MentionFilter

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| author | FilterClause> | Filter by author(s). |
| engagement | FilterClause> | Filter by engagement range. |
| influence | FilterClause> | Filter by influence score range. |
| influencer | FilterClause> | Filter by influencer(s). |
| interactions | FilterClause> | Filter by interactions range. |
| language | FilterClause> | Filter by language(s). |
| location | FilterClause> | Filter by location(s). |
| mentionType | FilterClause> | Filter by mention type(s). Allowed values: WEB, FACEBOOK, TWITTER, FORUM, COMMENT, YOUTUBE, DISQUS, INSTAGRAM, TRIPADVISOR, VKONTAKTE, REDDIT |
| reach | FilterClause> | Filter by reach range. |
| sentiment | FilterClause> | Filter by sentiment. Allowed values: POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, NEGATIVE, UNDEFINED. |
| tag | FilterClause> | Filter by tag(s). |
| text | FilterClause | Filter mentions that contain exact keyword or phrase. |
| virality | FilterClause> | Filter mentions by virality range. |

###### FilterClause

| **param** | **description** |
| --- | --- |
| any | Return results that must have any of specified value(s). |
| all | Return results that have all of specified value(s). |
| not | Omit any value(s) from returned results. |

###### Range

| **param** | **description** |
| --- | --- |
| from | Return results where value is equal or greater than specified value. |
| to | Return results where value is equal or less than specified value. |

#### DateInterval

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| from | Date | Start datetime in milliseconds epoch time. |
| to | Date | End datetime in milliseconds epoch time. |

### PagedRequest

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| count | int | Number of results to return. |
| sorted | Sorted | Specify sorting property and direction. See Sorted for object definition. |

#### Sorted

| **param** | **type** | **description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| direction | enum | Sort direction. Accepted values: ASC, DESC |
| property | enum | Sorted by property. Accepted values: PUBLISHED_TIME, FEED_TIME, REACH, VIRALITY |
